issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Minneapolis Woman Sentenced to 51 Months in Prison for Role in Feeding Our Future $250 Million Fraud Scheme
supports: Sahra Mohamed Nur was sentenced to 51 months in prison and two years of supervised release.
Nur was ordered to pay $5,000,240 in restitution.
does_not_support: The restitution order is not proof that $5,000,240 has been collected.
